notes.title: Closed Playtest Starts on May 12 — Join Us!
notes.content:
📅 Start Date: May 12, 2025
🕹 Format: Closed Playtest
📣 Who Can Join: Everyone is welcome

Hey survivors!

On May 12, we're kicking off a closed playtest of our game, and we'd love to have you onboard. This is your chance to:

[list]
[*] test out new mechanics and content;

[*] be among the first to experience the latest updates;

[*] provide valuable feedback and help us improve the game!
[/list]

👉 To participate, just click the “Request Access” button on the game’s Steam page. Slots are limited, so don’t wait too long!

Thanks for supporting us — see you in the game!
